CONTENT.P1: During this Silent Retreat, Swami Atmananda invites us to deepen our understanding of Consciousness, Spiritual Awakening, and Self-Realization, in the tradition of Advaita Vedanta.
CONTENT.P2: The silence maintained throughout the retreat will create a favourable atmosphere, allowing a profound process of Awakening to unfold among the participants.
CONTENT.P3: There is no 'awakened person', only the pure presence of the Self...

QUOTE.TEXT: You are the Truth, the Self, the timeless Consciousness
QUOTE.AUTHOR: - Swami Atmananda Udasin -

CONTENT.P1: Swami Atmananda Udasin is the Head Monk under whose guidance the Ajatananda Ashram community in Rishikesh, India, operates. The Ashram is an interreligious monastic community dedicated to the Unity of Truth and devoted to welcoming and supporting spiritual seekers from all religious traditions.
CONTENT.P2: Swami Atmananda teaches the Direct Path of Non-Duality in the tradition of Advaita Vedanta and offers regular satsangs and retreats both in India and abroad.
CONTENT.P3: After a brief career as a university lecturer, Swami Atmananda felt called to monastic life and spent ten years in solitude, first in a hermitage near Jerusalem and later in northern India, dedicating himself to deep spiritual practice. Towards the end of this silent and solitary retreat, he embraced Sanatana Dharma and, in 2001, received initiation into sannyasa (Indian monastic renunciation) from his beloved Master, H.H. Sri Chandra Swami Udasin, whom he had met in Haridwar in 1990.
CONTENT.P4: Since 2012, his teachings have inspired spiritual seekers from around the world, guiding them toward deep Awakening and inner peace.

ABOUT_ORGANIZER.TITLE: About the Organizers
ABOUT_ORGANIZER.P1: The retreat is organized by the French association Les Amis d’Ajatananda Ashram in close partnership with Vimarśānandanātha (Dan) and Lakshmi Bărbuș.
ABOUT_ORGANIZER.P2: Founded in France in December 2015, the Association supports the activities of the interfaith community of Ajatananda Ashram in Rishikesh, India, as well as the retreats and satsangs in Europe led by Swami Atmananda Udasin.
ABOUT_ORGANIZER.P3: In service of the Ashram, the Association helps share the teachings of Advaita (Non-Duality) transmitted by Swami Atmananda with spiritual seekers.
ABOUT_ORGANIZER.P4: If you would like to support the Association in its mission, you may become a member here.

SUPPORT.TITLE: Teachings
SUPPORT.DESCRIPTION: All programmes organized by the Ashram in India and Europe are offered free of charge. The Ajatananda Ashram is a non-profit organization and depends entirely on donations to cover daily expenses. If you feel inspired to support the Ashram and contribute to the promotion of its activities in the field of non-dual teachings and interreligious dialogue, you are welcome to do so through the Donation Box during the retreat or online at ajatananda.org.

LOCATION.DESCRIPTION: This event has an extended residential character, designed to maintain the continuity of the experience throughout the entire retreat. Even though sleeping arrangements may vary, all core activities, Satsang sessions and silent meals will take place together within the main villa.
LOCATION.ACCOMMODATION:
​Regarding accommodation, participants typically stay in the surrounding area, where there are multiple options available just a few minutes' walk away. This setup is ideal as it grants you the freedom to choose the type of space that suits you best, while staying close to the heart of the program.
​As for staying directly in the main villa, these spaces are usually claimed at the very beginning of the registration process. However, if you would prefer this option, please contact us so we can check if any availability remains or if a spot has opened up.
LOCATION.FOOD: Regardless of where you choose to stay, all participants will share meals and spend their practice time in the main villa, forming a united community throughout the retreat. The program is specifically designed so that the flow of the experience remains seamless for everyone.
LOCATION.EXTRA_INFO: ​If you need further information about nearby options or registration details, please reach out to us, we are here to help!

TRAVEL.TITLE: How to Get to the Retreat (Peștera Village)
TRAVEL.INTRO: Whether you are coming from abroad or from Bucharest, we have put together the simplest ways to reach our picturesque venue in the village of Peștera.

OPTION1.TITLE: 🚐 Option 1: Direct Transfer (Recommended)
OPTION1.SUBTITLE: The most comfortable option for those landing at Otopeni Airport (Bucharest).
OPTION1.LAST_STEP: Final step: From Bran, the venue is approximately 15 minutes by local taxi.
OPTION1.BOOKING: Booking: You can reserve and pay your seat in advance at transfer-lowcost.ro.

OPTION2.TITLE: 🚆 Option 2: Train + Taxi
OPTION2.SUBTITLE: A scenic option, ideal for avoiding Prahova Valley traffic during peak hours.
OPTION2.ROUTE: Route: Otopeni Airport → Bucharest Nord Station → Brașov Station
OPTION2.LAST_STEP: Final step: From Brașov Station, you can take a taxi, Uber, or Bolt to Peștera village.
OPTION2.TICKETS: Train tickets: Check the schedule on CFR Călători. The CFR website is usually sufficient, but it may also direct you to their partners Astra Transcarpatic, Regio Călători, or Softrans, which you can also check directly.

NOTES.TITLE: 📌 Important Notes
NOTES.LOCAL: Local transport: In Brașov you can confidently use Uber or Bolt.
NOTES.BRAN_AREA: In the Bran/Peștera area: While ride-sharing apps appear to be available, the number of cars is limited. For safety and punctuality, we recommend using local taxis.
NOTES.RETURN: Return journey: The same options apply on the way back. We recommend planning your transfer in advance.
